global_contract.base: Use injected gcli-service-base/root_path for every HTTP/blob/OAuth/WS URL; paths here are node-relative. Never prepend UI route path or an AG API prefix to shared panel routes.

global_contract.panel_auth_failure: Existing authenticatedHTTP401 detail=密码错误; newsummary missingBearer401 detail=panel_authentication_required; old HTTPBearer missing header may403. Generic outer401 alone is insufficient on explicit upstream operations.
global_contract.upstream_auth_failure: Old GCLI test/Preview can return Google401 as outerHTTP401 with success:false/filename/status_code orstep. AG manual response_source/upstream_status and newsummary DTO upstream_status differentiate. Such errors never clear panel session.
global_contract.http_success: 200 may businesssuccess:false,partialfailure,localpending or unsupported stats fallback. Preserve actualsuccess/status_code/upstream_status/state_update and unknowns independently.
global_contract.privacy: CredentialJSON/errors/password reveal confirmation everyopening; exports explicitaction; no persistent sensitive caches/logs/URL/postMessage. Raw errorbody never used ordinary safe views.
global_contract.manual_only: Import/OAuth/RT/verify/test/Preview/legacyquota/emailfetch/dedup/storage switch only explicit useraction; fixture gate DEV&&VITE_UI_FIXTURES dynamically imports synthetic fixtures and sends zero real requests.
global_contract.cancellation: Abort stale reads, stop unlaunchedbatchitems; never claim launched external work rolledback. Clear transient authURL/callbackcode/RT/plaintext on close/logout/mode replacement.
